location: U8 thermal pad / (144.5 mm, 78.5 mm, F.Cu/B.Cu)
finding: ESP32-S3 exposed pad thermal vias spaced < 0.20 mm drill-to-drill, causing 48 hole-to-hole DRC violations under JLCPCB manufacturing rules.
evidence: drc_report.json: 48 violations of hole_to_hole (drill distance < 0.20 mm)
standard_violated: JLCPCB Capability Limit: Hole-to-hole spacing minimum 0.20 mm; Target >= 0.50 mm
root_cause: Dense thermal via array placed without respecting drill diameter and annular clearance spacing limits.
proposed_fix: Relieve via matrix into a 3x3 array of 9 standard 0.30 mm drill / 0.60 mm pad vias with 0.55 mm hole-to-hole clearance (DEC-003).
rationale: 9 vias with 0.3 mm drill provide an equivalent thermal resistance R_th < 8 K/W for ESP32-S3 (P_diss = 1.1 W max), keeping junction temp well below 85 deg C while completely clearing DRC.
side_effects: Verified ground continuity and thermal dissipation on bottom copper ground pour.
verification_method: kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all --refill-zones reports 0 hole_to_hole errors.

finding: 4 dangling track segments and 2 dangling vias causing impedance discontinuities, EMI antennas, and DRC warnings.
evidence: drc_report.json: 4 track_dangling warnings and 2 via_dangling warnings
standard_violated: /pcb-layout-engineer Layout sequence - No acute angles, dangling stubs, or unintentional antennas
root_cause: Incomplete trace cleanup from previous component placement iterations.
proposed_fix: Prune all unconnected dangling track stubs and dangling vias while verifying 100% netlist connectivity.
rationale: Eliminating dangling stubs eliminates quarter-wave antenna radiation at 2.4 GHz and switching transients.
side_effects: Verified 0 unrouted nets and 100% netlist completion.
verification_method: kicad-cli pcb drc reports 0 track_dangling and 0 via_dangling items.

finding: 5 silkscreen text elements on B.SilkS were unmirrored, resulting in reversed printing on manufactured boards.
standard_violated: /pcb-dfm-engineer - Bottom layer silkscreen text must be mirrored for readability post-fabrication
root_cause: Text placed on B.SilkS without the mirror attribute enabled.
proposed_fix: Enable mirror attribute and appropriate justification on all B.SilkS text elements.
rationale: Ensures pinouts and branding on bottom layer are legible after assembly.
side_effects: Checked text boundaries against board outline and pads.
verification_method: kicad-cli pcb drc reports 0 nonmirrored_text_on_back_layer warnings.

finding: 68 silkscreen text annotations placed directly over exposed SMD copper pads, risking solderability and tombstoning.
standard_violated: JLCPCB Target: Silkscreen text clearance >= 0.15 mm from exposed solder pads
root_cause: Autoplaced reference designators positioned inside footprint pad courtyards.
proposed_fix: Reposition all reference designators and pin labels >= 0.15 mm outside exposed SMD pad perimeters.
rationale: Prevents solder mask / silk ink encroachment into solder joints during reflow.
side_effects: Verified text does not collide with neighboring part courtyards.
verification_method: kicad-cli pcb drc reports 0 silk_over_copper warnings.

finding: 46 silkscreen text collisions between component references, values, and functional pin labels.
root_cause: Dense packing of passives without manual text layout optimization.
proposed_fix: Deconflict all overlapping silkscreen texts, hide redundant passive value labels, and orient references consistently.
rationale: Clear silkscreen designators enable rapid optical inspection (AOI) and rework.
side_effects: Verified visibility of all functional IC references.
verification_method: kicad-cli pcb drc reports 0 silk_overlap warnings.

finding: Schematic symbol overlaps, collided wire junctions in reset circuitry, misaligned +3V3/GND symbols, and snubber orientation collisions.
evidence: CopperPilotDrone.kicad_sch diff: 149 lines modified to resolve symbol body and wire collisions
standard_violated: /schematic-conventions Default conventions - Clean signal flow, no 4-way junctions, aligned power symbols
root_cause: Rapid schematic capture without enforcing strict 50-mil connection grid alignment.
proposed_fix: Untangle reset switch SW2, decoupling caps C9-C11, R18, and motor snubber diodes D2-D5 / R29-R32 onto grid.
rationale: Eliminates ambiguity in schematic review and achieves 100% schematic-to-PCB parity.
side_effects: Netlist verified unchanged; 0 schematic parity issues in DRC.
verification_method: kicad-cli sch erc --severity-all reports 0 violations; DRC parity clean.

finding: 60 assembled SMD components lacked standard Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) property.
evidence: Section 9.3 Acceptance Test T6: BOM completeness assertion
standard_violated: JLCPCB SMT Production Requirement (T6) - Every assembled part must define Value, Footprint, MPN, and LCSC
root_cause: Parts had LCSC part numbers assigned but MPN field was omitted during initial library symbol placement.
proposed_fix: Inject standardized MPN attributes across all 60 passive and active components matching their verified LCSC parts.
rationale: Guarantees deterministic component procurement and cross-referencing during JLCPCB automated SMT ordering.
verification_method: T6 verification check reports 100% of 68 assembled components complete.

finding: NPTH mousebite perforation drill holes (0.20-0.30 mm spacing) triggered global hole-to-hole DRC errors.
evidence: drc_report.json: hole_to_hole warnings along frame breakaway tabs
standard_violated: JLCPCB Breakaway Tab Specification - Mouse bites require 0.5-0.8 mm holes with 0.2-0.3 mm pitch
root_cause: Global hole-to-hole clearance constraint (0.50 mm) applied indiscriminately to mechanical mousebite perforations.
proposed_fix: Add scoped custom design rule in CopperPilotDrone.kicad_dru allowing 0.15 mm min spacing for mounting holes (DEC-002).
rationale: Preserves strict 0.50 mm hole clearance for functional vias while allowing necessary high-density perforation rows.
side_effects: No impact on electrical routing; verified all electrical vias maintain >= 0.50 mm spacing.
verification_method: kicad-cli pcb drc passes cleanly with custom rule active.

finding: Missing comprehensive JLCPCB order parameters mapping and component rotation offset table.
standard_violated: JLCPCB Manufacturing Readiness Checklist Phase 7 (Fabrication & Assembly Documentation)
root_cause: Project lacked formalized JLCPCB online order specification document.
proposed_fix: Generate pcb/build/ORDER_SPEC.md via pcb/Makefile documenting all 24 quoting form fields, CPL rotation offsets, and stackup.
rationale: Prevents assembly delays, rotation discrepancies, and quote revision queries with the fabricator.
side_effects: Documentation artifact only; no layout side effects.
